views.markdown:
A minimal per-app mixer for rootless iPadOS. Playing apps appear automatically as one app icon and one slider; set a slider to zero to mute. System media volume has its own icon/slider row.

The package also adds an expandable SoundDeck module to Control Center. No enrollment is required. Recording, calls and VoiceProcessingIO are excluded.

**Experimental:** verified on iPad7,5 / iPadOS 17.7.8 with native fixtures and live Safari/Music gain checks. Starting Safari while Music was playing stopped Music; simultaneous playback is not guaranteed. See the project compatibility notes.
